paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab suante leh Ammon suante khenkhat toh Jehoshaphat sual ding in ahong kuan uhi.
heading: Edomte Toh Kidouna

paite: Huchi in kuate hiam in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Nang sual ding in mipi thupi mahmah, tuipi gal Siria a kipan ahong kuan uhi; ngai in, Hazazon-tamar ah a-omta ua, huai 'Engedi' leng achi uh," chi in agen uhi.
Jehoshaphat alau a, TOUPA zong ding in akipia a; Judah gam tengteng ah an ngawl ding thu athangsak hi.
Huchi in Judahte bel TOUPA panpihna zong in akikaikhawm ua; Judah kho chih a kipan TOUPA zong ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
Jehoshaphat TOUPA' inn ah, intual thak chin ah Judah leh Jerusalem kikaikhawm lak ah adingh a;
heading: Jehoshaphat Thumna Leh Vualzohna

paite: "Aw TOUPA ka pi-le-pute uh Pathian, van Pathian, van a Pathian na hi kei a hia? Namte' lalgam tung a vaihawmpa na hi kei a hia? Na khut ah thilhihtheihna leh hatna a-om a, kuamah zoh vual na hi kei hi.
Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai gam a tengte na mi Israelte na ma ah na delhkhiaksak a, na lawm Abraham suante tangtawn a dia na piak ahi kei maw?
Hiai gam ah ahong omta ua, na min a ding in mun siangthou ahon lamsak uhi.

Ka tung uah thil hoih lou, namsau a vaihawmnate hiam, hiite hiam, kialte hiam ahong tunleh hiai inn ma leh nangmah ma ah ka hong dingh ding ua, hiai inn ah lah na min a-om ngal a, ka mangbatna uah nang ka hon sam ding ua, nang na hon na ngaihkhiaksak in na hon hondam ding," chi in.
"Huchi in ngai in, Ammon suante leh Moabte leh Seir tang a mi, Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan ahong paikhiak lai un, amau asim uh na phal kei a, amau a kipan akiheimang zaw ua, amau ahihmang kei uhi.
Ka luah ding ua na hon piak gam a kipan hon delhkhe ding in ahong kuan uhi.

Aw ka Pathian uh, atung ua vaihawm lou ding na hi maw? Mi huai zahzah hon sual ding a hong kuante lah na sualthei ding dan mahmah ka hi kei ua; alohna dan ka thei kei ua, nang lam ka hong nga zaw mai uhi,” achi hi.
Judahte tengteng, anau neu chikchik uh, azite uh atate uh toh TOUPA ma ah adingh uhi.
Huchi in mipi lak ah Jahajiel tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, huai mi Zekariah tapa ahi a, huai mi Benaiah tapa ahi a, huai mi Jeiel tapa ahi a, huai mi Asaph suan Levi mi Mataniah tapa ahi.

Ama'n, "Nou Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a teng tengteng leh nang Jehoshaphat, na ngaikhia un: TOUPA'N na kiang uah hichi in achi, 'Lau kei unla, huai mipi thupi mahmahte ziak in leng lunglel sam kei un; kidouna noute kidouna ahi kei a, Pathian kidouna ahi zaw ngal a.
Zingchiang in va sual un; ngai dih ua, Ziz zottouhna ah ahong tou ua, Jeruel gamdai chin phaizang tawp lam ah na va mu ding uh.

Hiai kidouna na sual uh akiphamoh kei ding: kiphalh unla, adin in dingh mai unla, nou lam a pang TOUPA hotdamna tak en gige un, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw: lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un, zingchiang in sual ding in kuan un, TOUPA lah nou lam ah apang ngal a,' " achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel amai a lei si in akun a; Judah mite tengteng leh Jerusalem mite tengteng TOUPA bia in TOUPA ma ah akun uhi.
Kohath suan leh Korah suan Levite aw ngaihtak a TOUPA Israel' Pathian phat ding in ahong dinghta uhi.

Huchi in zingsang in zingkhang in athou ua, Tekoa gamdai ah alut ua; apai lai un Jehoshaphat adingh a, "Aw, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA na Pathian uh ging unla, kiptak in dingh unla, azawlneite gingta un, hileh lamzangtak in na om ding uh," achi hi.

Mipite ahanthawn khit in sepaihte ma a pai kawm a TOUPA pahtawina leh asiangthou kilawmdan phat ding a lasami dingte a sep hi, "Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, azahngaihna lah tangtawn in a-om sin ngal a, chi un," achi hi.
Huan la asak ua aphattak un Ammon suante, Moab suante, tang a mite Judate sual ding a hong kuante guktan ding mite TOUPA'N akoih a; avuallelta uhi.
Ammon suante leh Moab suante'n Seir tang a omte thah chimih vek leh hihman sipsip tum in asualta uhi. Seir tang a mite ahihman khit un amau leh amau kihihman tum in akisual nilouh uhi.
Judahte'n gamdai etna mun sang ava tun uleh mipi lam a-en ua; ngai dih, misi luang lei ah apuk zengzung a, khat lel leng asuakta kei uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat leh aheute gallak la ding in ava hoh ua, alak uah sum-le-paite, puansilhte, suangmantamte ava mu ua, apuak zoh louh khop un ala ua, atam petmah a, ni thum tak gallak asek uhi.
Ani li ni in Berakah Phaizang ah akikhawm ua, huai ah TOUPA apahtawi ua; huaiziak in tutan in huai lai mun, Berakah Phaizang achi uhi.
Huchi in Judah mi leh Jerusalem mi tengteng apai nawn ua Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a nuamsatak a pai ding in ama uh akai hi; TOUPA'N amelmate uh tungthu a nuamsatak a a-omsak ziak in.
Huchi in pekgingte, kaihgingte, pengkulte toh Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn atungtou uhi.
TOUPA'N Israelte melma asual chih atheih un, gam chih a mite'n Pathian alauta uhi.
Huchi in Jehoshaphat gam galmuang in a-omta a; a Pathian in akimvel a mite lak a galmuanna apiak ziak in.
Jehoshaphat in Judah tung ah vai ahawmta a; kum sawmthum-le-nga a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm a; anu min Azubah, Silhi tanu ahi.
heading: Jehoshaphat Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (1 Kum 22.41-50)

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in apa Asa lampi pialsan het lou in azui hi.
Himahleh mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a, mipite'n leng apipute uh Pathian tung ah alungtang uh anga tuan sam kei uh.
Huan ngai dih ua, Jehoshaphat thilhih tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in Hanani tapa Jehu tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang a, Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
Huai nung in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa Ahaziah, thil hoih loutak a hihsekpa akithutuahpih hi:
Tarshish lam a pai ding long abawlkhawm ua, Ezion-geber ah longte abawl uhi.

Huchi in Mareshah mi Dodavah tapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ahaziah na kithuahpih ziak in TOUPA'N na thilhih tup ahon hihsiatsakta ahi," achi hi. Huchi in longte akise vek ua, Tarshish ah ahoh thei kei uhi.
